notes: Per-part appearance, a port addition (port/include/phantomcrash/part_looks.hpp): a part in the stock can wear the mesh of another part of its kind, chosen with left and right (or a click on the arrows) on ASSEMBLE's list and on Wild Machines' BUY MODULE list; each screen's look_arrows places the arrows, and a screen without them offers no looks. Whole SVs (the dealers, used SVs) are sold as they are.

Only the drawn robot changes. The part's stats, and the collision radius, stride speeds and motion timings the battle reads, stay the part's own: the battle runs on the robot's own parts and the look follows on a second pose that is only drawn. The stock entry keeps its look ("look" in the save, the part id whose mesh it wears).

One look per distinct mesh, the first part to draw it standing for it. weapons_keep_kind keeps a weapon to looks of its own weapon kind (a blade wears blades); arms_keep_class keeps an arm weapon to its arm class, so its poses still fit. enabled false offers no looks; looks already chosen still show.
VS mode's saved Scoobees, online and co-op battles draw the parts themselves.
